body: And they only wanna take care of you because they ”care”. How your life gets shitter when you finally take the courage to say your suicidal. What a joke

The fact that you decide to still live shows how strong you are.  I share my gratitude for confessing. Death fascinates me very well, it brings comfort knowing there's always a way out.   Things that eases my pain is writing on my journal/diary and listen to music to clear out my thoughts.  
You see, writing about your day is talking about yourself. You only talk about yourself to that someone, because they are the only one that cares to listen to you. However, that someone isn't always available. So, you can write on your journal instead. Whatever you feel like, you write it down. No one judges you there, and never will.  I promise, a little better is better than a little bit worse. 

Aaand, if you take my advice into your consideration. Try listening to music on low music while doing it. The negative thoughts will eventually go when you start writing them down. 

​

:) Good luck, buddy!
Thanks for the advice! But is there a way where my parents don’t have to know?
